name: ToastyReplay-Lite
description: A lightweight version of ToastyReplay with a native Geometry Dash interface.

tps-bypass.name: TPS Bypass
tps-bypass.description: Runs gameplay physics at the selected TPS. Use only one TPS bypass at a time.

tps-rate.name: TPS
tps-rate.description: Higher values increase physics resolution and CPU use. Input precision depends on the input system.
